metadata.case_name: TANG BO LING v. CHAN PO T/A CORRYTRON CATERIES

injuries.description: fracture of the left wrist, her left distal radius and ulnar styloid.
source: At the hospital, she was found to have suffered a fracture of the left wrist, her left distal radius and ulnar styloid.
The doctors found Miss Tang has a mild decrease in the range of movement of the left wrist.
They found a mildly prominent ulnar styloid which was contributed by the mild dorsal displacement of the distal radius due to the fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: Long and persistent pain on left wrist
Restricted movement of left wrist / mild decrease in range of movement
Lack of strength of left wrist
Poor sleep throughout the initial period of her recuperation
Unable to lift or carry kindergarten pupils
Interference with bathing due to restricted left wrist movements
Persistent on and off pain, numbness and lack of strength (residual complaints)

treatments_received: Close reduction and long arm plaster
treatments_future: Medical attention from time to time due to persistent pain and weakness of left wrist (court found sum of HKD 15,000 reasonable)

losses.description: Persistent pain, numbness, lack of strength and reduced range of movement of the left wrist.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Restricted left wrist movements had interfered with her bathing.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Seldom played basketball and badminton with her children and had to give up playing volleyball with her team-mates.
Reduced social gatherings and activities because she felt embarrassed about her injuries.
